text: During an English Civil War battle, the alchemist's assistant Whitehead [flees the fighting and falls in with three deserters|trigger|running from trouble], promised an alehouse. Instead they reach a field where they [eat a meal of wild mushrooms|images|plants, trees and fungus], then [rope a carved post out of the earth and unbury the alchemist O'Neill|trigger|unsealing what was shut away]. O'Neill takes command, tortures Whitehead into a human divining rod, and sets the men [digging for buried treasure|wants|wealth and ambition] as the mushrooms take hold of their minds.
